behavior: The existing PAPERCUSP_P011_COUNTER_PID selector retains scalar behavior and also accepts an explicit list of at most eight distinct safe integer PIDs. No new config key, service, tool or worker-count setting.

Each selected target must belong to the exact maintained main/descendant ancestry and executable entry. The sampler reuses the maintained collectRequestWorkerWindow callback seam for per-target unforced PSS/allocation and exact HTTP/query/process/build/role joins.

Inspectors are acquired and released per PID with OS lifetime, executable, entry and parent pins. Preexisting inspectors are detached without closing their listener. Partial acquisition is included in cleanup, one close/detach failure does not skip another target, and reused PIDs are never closed.

Scalar sidecar observations retain their prior counter/IPC path; multiple selections require identified request-only roles. Legacy report samples remain first-PID observations. Unsampled workers, evicted request rings and census residue remain explicitly unknown.
Cleanup errors preserve the original sampler error in the terminal failure and report.
